+import os
+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+from document_models import DocumentRequest, normalize_response
+
+
+def load_documentai_config(config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    return {
+        "project_id": config.get("project_id") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"),
+        "location": config.get("location") or os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_LOCATION", "us"),
+        "processor_id": config.get("processor_id") or os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID"),
+    }
+
+
+def get_documentai_client(config=None):
+    config = load_documentai_config(config)
+    return documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"}
+    ), config
+
+
+def process_document(payload, config=None):
+    client, config = get_documentai_client(config)
+    request = payload if isinstance(payload, DocumentRequest) else DocumentRequest(**payload)
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(
+        request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(content=request.document_bytes, mime_type=request.mime_type)}
+    )
+    return response
+
+
+def document_entities_to_response(response):
+    fields, items = {}, []
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ == "line_item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            items.append({"description": values.get("description"), "quantity": values.get("quantity"), "amount": values.get("amount")})
+        else:
+            fields[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+    return normalize_response(fields=fields, items=items, raw=response)

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])})
+    document = response.document
+    normalized = {"merchant": None, "date": None, "currency": None, "total": None, "items": []}
+    for entity in document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ in normalized and entity.type_ != "items":
+            normalized[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+        elif entity.type_ == "line_item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            normalized["items"].append(values)
+    return {"expense": normalized}

+import os
+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+from document_models import DocumentRequest, normalize_response
+
+
+def load_documentai_config(config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    return {
+        "project_id": config.get("project_id") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"),
+        "location": config.get("location") or os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_LOCATION", "us"),
+        "processor_id": config.get("processor_id") or os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID"),
+    }
+
+
+def get_documentai_client(config=None):
+    config = load_documentai_config(config)
+    return documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"}
+    ), config
+
+
+def process_document(payload, config=None):
+    client, config = get_documentai_client(config)
+    request = payload if isinstance(payload, DocumentRequest) else DocumentRequest(**payload)
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(
+        request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(content=request.document_bytes, mime_type=request.mime_type)}
+    )
+    return response
+
+
+def document_entities_to_response(response):
+    fields, items = {}, []
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ == "line_item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            items.append({"description": values.get("description"), "quantity": values.get("quantity"), "amount": values.get("amount")})
+        else:
+            fields[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+    return normalize_response(fields=fields, items=items, raw=response)

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])})
+    document = response.document
+    normalized = {"merchant": None, "date": None, "currency": None, "total": None, "items": []}
+    for entity in document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ in normalized and entity.type_ != "items":
+            normalized[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+        elif entity.type_ == "line_item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            normalized["items"].append(values)
+    return {"expense": normalized}

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])})
+    required = {"supplier_name", "invoice_date", "total_amount"}
+    seen = {}
+    confidences = {}
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        seen[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+        confidences[entity.type_] = getattr(entity, "confidence", None)
+    return {"valid": required.issubset(set(seen)), "fields": seen, "confidence": confidences}

+import os
+from google.cloud import firestore
+
+
+def expense_record_store(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = firestore.Client(project=config.get("project_id") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"))
+    collection = config.get("collection", "expense_records")
+    data = payload.get("record", payload)
+    doc_ref = client.collection(collection).document(config.get("document_id") or data.get("id") or client.collection(collection).document().id)
+    doc_ref.set(data)
+    return {"document_id": doc_ref.id, "collection": collection}
